8.32. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.relation¶

The module defines predicate classes representing releations in the mathematical sense.

Classes

Constant(const[, argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(obj)’ for each obj of type ALL_TYPE_C if the argument const is True.
Equal([argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(obj, obj)’ for each obj in the domain of ALL_TYPE_C.
OrdinalSuccessor(ordinalUserType[, argOrder])
Reflexive(predArg[, args, argOrder])
Singleton(predArg[, argOrder])
Symmetric(predArg[, args, argOrder])
Transitive(predArg[, args, argOrder]) Predicate class that converts the given predicate to its transitive closure in terms of two specified components (of the same base type) in the signature of the predicate.
Union(predArgList, signature) Predicate class that build a true point set which is the union of the true point sets of the given predicates.
